Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding student involvement in higher education governance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to student involvement in higher educationgovernance; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Students at each institution of higher education shall be activeparticipants in the immediate governance of and policy development oftheir respective institutions of higher education. The undergraduateand graduate student governments at each respective institution ofhigher education are the entities through which student participationoccurs. Any governance responsibility and authority, and any policydevelopment, is subject to the authority of the respective governingbodies of the institutions of higher education.
